title: Feature-level analysis and adversarial transfer in rotationally equivariant quantum machine learning
summary: Group-equivariant quantum models are designed to exploit symmetry and can improve trainability, but it remains unclear how symmetry constraints shape their adversarial robustness. We study this question through a feature-level analysis of equivariant quantum models in a transfer-attack setting. Under equivariance with an invariant readout, predictions depend only on the group-twirled input, which identifies the symmetry-invariant information accessible to the model together with a complementary uninformative subspace.
